Nacho Ride

Ann Arbor, MI · Road

Nacho Ride is a road group ride in Ann Arbor, MI. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Homes Brewery. About 43 miles, slow, then fast for the last 15 km, then nachos. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, then fast for the last 15 km, then nachos. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Nacho Ride group ride

Out-and-back on one straight road from Homes Brewery. Most of it is chill; the last stretch home gets fast. Ends with nachos. Listed as no-drop style by Wheels in Motion.
